degraded: Server suite (3928 passed / 5 skipped, 350 files) was re-run in full for F0 completeness, but no server file was changed by this iterate — recorded for completeness, not because server code was touched.

Internal review cascade (spec/code/doubt) plus external code review (Codex + GLM, both legs 'revise') found and fixed a real correctness gap: hasMoreToLoad/isAtWindowCeiling only checked per-lead page saturation and silently under-reported when the COMBINED filtered total across leads exceeded windowSize — fixed and covered by a new regression test before merge.

External code review also flagged the default-all checkbox state as visually ambiguous (unchecked = 'everything included' rather than 'nothing selected'); addressed via clarifying legend text + tooltip rather than inverting the checked-by-default state, since inverting would have broken the separate, spec-mandated guarantee that an unmapped event kind (no checkbox exists for it) still renders by default.
